The search returned **11,779 records** using the Entrez-date cutoff of January 24, 2016; it has no publication-date limit. It retrieved all **14/14 development** and **4/4 held-out** records. That is relative recall against a small, internally assembled set, not an estimate of sensitivity across the literature.

I tested a traumatic-event block, but requiring it would lose a held-out record and three relevant records, so it was left out. The final count exceeds the 10,000-record workload budget; that trade-off is documented in the audit.
